description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams that extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate filtering parameters for employee license searches, specifically allowing setting and getting an employee number and defining allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee license search results, including sorting options and employee number filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters and sets the default sort field to 'el.licenseIssuedDate'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the search filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the search filter.
